answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake of earned coins behind its identity before it can transact. Like basalt bedrock under shifting dune sand, the stake anchors reputation to real cost: a single honest identity pays once, while a Sybil attacker must fund each fake separately, and every proven fraud slashes the stake. Honest agents recover their deposit plus fees, but a forger's copies crumble like shale under pressure, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of stakes. The ledger makes the price public, so the attack stops paying before it starts.
